Later additions elaborate rather than first invent those obligations.
requirements.current_disposition: April8 is an observed predecessor bound, not the unknown original creation date. Governance text proves a requirement existed; it does not prove implementation complied or that any person knowingly deceived Joe.
requirements.lawful_remedy: Carry these requirements into each mechanism specification and actual update/decision-law audit. Identify a precise original approval for an exception; absence of an ML library, determinism or a physical name cannot establish compliance. Keep L0–L4 frozen.

requirements.module_acceptance: Trace all actual producers, consumers and persisted states across native/Python boundaries with full field and clock identity.
requirements.system_acceptance: Qualify acquired cognition, syntax and autonomy through ordinary retained-state behavior with matched controls on the exact preserved release.
requirements.release_acceptance: Bind the approved requirement, actual source, compiled release, active acquired state and independent live evidence. This historical governance review is neither enforcement nor qualification; no speech, system or ML-free certificate.

requirements.name: Anti-facade hardening must apply to mechanisms rather than banned tokens
requirements.historical_requirement_or_mechanism: AG008 explicitly rejects truncated ternary positions, fake smoothing as biophysics, dimensionless billion multipliers, sidecars bypassing canonical state and engineering solely to make tests green. Missing capabilities must remain explicit failures. The Anvil additions preserve invariants under pressure.
requirements.current_disposition: A strict XFAIL is not evidence of capability; a false scientific label is not a lawful mechanism. Conversely a derived joule-to-nanojoule conversion, a declared work ceiling or Joe’s specifically approved functional vocal oscillator is not disqualified merely because a number or cosine appears. Earlier source-specific reconciliations preserve those distinctions.
requirements.lawful_remedy: Classify every actual law, parameter, state change and test predicate with original authority and units. Preserve valid functional emulation and actual sound while refusing fabricated learned speech. Report the exact first failed causal boundary and its lawful repair; neither guaranteed emergence nor permanent speech impossibility is proved.
requirements.unit_acceptance: Test exact mathematical/physical invariants and unsupported-boundary refusal; no softening expected values, fabricated inputs or hidden state mutations.
requirements.module_acceptance: Trace ordinary hearing, retention, recall, ordered motor control, pressure and self-hearing independently; an isolated organ fixture cannot pass the learned chain.
requirements.system_acceptance: Require intelligible, experience-dependent, grounded later use and relational syntax where claimed, with preserved-state controls and exact release binding.
requirements.release_acceptance: Bind the approved requirement, actual source, compiled release, active acquired state and independent live evidence. This historical governance review is neither enforcement nor qualification; no speech, system or ML-free certificate.
